description_en: Associates an Elastic IP Address (EIP) with a cloud product instance on the same edge node
description_zh: 调用AssociateEnsEipAddress将弹性公网IP（EIP）绑定到同节点的云产品实例上
kebab_example: aliyun ens associate-ens-eip-address --allocation-id eip-5sc1sgcrsrwgwdvx44hru0000 --instance-id lb-5saivuir6b1mupxjfbhmk0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AssociateEnsEipAddress

parameters.help_en: The ID of the EIP to be associated
parameters.name: allocation_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cloud product instance to attach the EIP to.
Load balancing (ELB) instance IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh:
绑定EIP的云产品ID。
支持负载均衡（ELB）实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the EIP instance. Valid values:

Nat: NAT gateway.
SlbInstance: load balancing (ELB).
NetworkInterface: secondary network interface controller (NIC).
NatSlbInstance: select this value when attaching multiple EIPs to an ELB.
EnsInstance (default): ENS instance
parameters.help_zh:
EIP实例的类型，取值：

Nat：NAT网关。
SlbInstance：负载均衡（ELB）。
NetworkInterface：辅助弹性网卡。
NatSlbInstance：ELB绑定多EIP时，需要选此值。
EnsInstance（默认值）：ENS实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the EIP is a standby EIP. Valid values:

true: standby.

false: not standby
parameters.help_zh:
是否备用EIP。取值：

true：备用。

false：非备用
parameters.name: standby
